description: A softness-descending confidence mixer: Linha-Fina (trained statistical classifier) leads at high, Palavreado (order-independent keyword bag, no learning) backs it at medium, Nebulento (fuzzy string matching, the loosest/most tolerant of the three) closes at low.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: unlike trident (three-tier but engines picked for architectural distinctness), cascade-soft is picked for a deliberately monotonic 'strictness' gradient — trained classifier (least tolerant of paraphrase, most precise) -> rigid-but-vocab-flexible keyword bag -> fuzzy matcher (most tolerant of ASR noise/typos, least precise) — to test whether ordering engines by how loosely they match, not just by paradigm, is itself a useful axis distinct from trident's paradigm-diversity axis. Linha-Fina is a template-paradigm statistical classifier (see ENGINE_REGISTRY: 'linha_fina.opm:LinhaFinaPipeline', paradigm='template') distinct from both Jurebes (sklearn baseline family) and Padatious (neural+exact-gate), so this fighter and trident do not test the same top stage. exact_match not applicable to linha-fina/palavreado/nebulento (jurebes-only config key, verified absent from linha_fina/opm.py and palavreado/opm.py's self.config.get(...) call sites).
